subject.title: feat: enable the new exec approvals pipeline behind an opt-in setting

question: Should this release include the manually configured, default-off exec-approvals preview even though active MXC intentionally makes the preview unavailable and interactive prompt and Settings UI support are not yet present?
rationale: The patch and current-head proof establish fail-closed behavior, but automated review cannot decide whether this temporary operator experience and alternate command-authorization boundary match the intended rollout policy.

options.title: Approve guarded preview
options.body: Ship the hidden default-off setting for advanced operators, retain the fail-closed MXC gate, and track transport and UI completion separately.

options.title: Wait for complete workflow
options.body: Hold the PR until direct-argv sandbox transport, interactive prompting, discoverable configuration, diagnostics, and in-product recovery can ship together.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded preview
recommendation.body: Ship the hidden default-off setting for advanced operators, retain the fail-closed MXC gate, and track transport and UI completion separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior system.run security-policy work and review involvement make them the strongest available owner for the rollout boundary.
